svg.title: Annotated review of the Common Ground repair flyer
svg.desc: Six numbered observations identify the original wrong date, faint supporting text, oversized entry badge, small preparation text, clipped welcome and generic decoration. The corrected A5 design appears alongside the unchanged original.
svg.text: Numbered observations on the unchanged source, with corrections implemented in a separate A5 master.
The date is wrong; small pale logistics
also make the visit harder to plan.
with date, time and venue enlarged.
Observed · name and descriptor are pale
Changed · dark ink, clear type and
Give entry cost the right weight
at A5 and has limited contrast.
Keep the welcome on the page
beyond the right edge and is clipped.
line with a clear lower margin.
Observed · circle and star supply colour
Measured on the final digital files
A5 · 148 × 210 mm. Minimum type: 13.46 pt. Main text contrast: 10.65:1. All nine approved copy items present.
Contrast uses opaque sRGB pairs. Digital checks do not certify print reproduction or audience accessibility. No physical proof or audience test.
